request.prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the noolim, a darting shoal of dull silver slivers from the dark floor of the Twilight, seen as a shoal and never as one individual. The shoal is a loose, open cloud of about twenty separate short slivers. Each sliver is a small, slim, slightly tapered shape of dull silver, with a smooth edge and a clean dark outline of its own. It has no fin, no tail and no head. The slivers sit at different angles and depths, with clear gaps of transparent background between neighbours, and three or four strays drift just outside the main spread. The cloud keeps the same compact oval envelope and the same sliver shapes in every facing. Front view (south): seen head-on, the slivers' pointed leading tips converge toward the viewer, with their bodies foreshortened behind them. Rear view (north): seen from behind, the slivers' blunt trailing ends recede away from the viewer, in the same oval envelope and at the same width as the front view. Side views (east and west): the slivers lie side-on in a loose layer of single slivers with open space showing through the centre, all pointing the same way along the direction of travel. Colouring is dull, unlit silver with soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style. Exactly ONE shoal, centred, the whole cloud visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
